content.text:
Done. The "Read reviews on Amazon" text is gone from the review card, replaced with a clickable star rating.

What changed in `components/ProductRating.tsx` (used on the review page for both the main pick and the alternative offers):

- Only the star rating and its score (e.g. ★★★★☆ 4.3) are shown now; the "Read reviews..." text link is removed.
- Clicking the stars opens that offer's product page on whichever store it's from (Amazon, Walmart, etc.), where the reviews live. Hovering shows a tooltip like "4.3 out of 5 stars at Amazon".
- Offers that have no rating (like older catalog items) now show no rating row at all, since there are no stars to display. The product's title box is still a link to the store, so those items remain reachable.

Validated with `npm run typecheck`, which passed. Committed as `bfc835d` and pushed to `origin/main`; note the push also carried the previously unpushed commit `8e74bd0` that was already sitting on the branch. Nothing else from the other in-progress work was staged.
